source.title: Film Production Roles and Responsibilities
source.note: Role boundaries vary by jurisdiction, union agreement, format, budget and negotiated scope.

invariant: Every registry role receives exactly one explicit disposition in every team contribution plan; simulation never impersonates a licensed, legal, safety-critical, consent, employment, financial or final-approval authority.

roles.name: Executive Producer (EP)
roles.core_responsibility: Secures or helps secure financing, rights, strategic partnerships, major talent, distribution support, or senior oversight. The credit can be creative, financial, contractual, or honorary; its practical meaning must be confirmed on each project.

roles.name: Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Owns the project’s overall delivery: develops the material, assembles key talent, creates the financing and production strategy, supervises budget and schedule at a high level, manages senior decision-making, and delivers the completed film.

roles.name: Co-producer
roles.core_responsibility: Shares defined producer-level duties, often across a financing partner, production company, region, or creative workstream.

roles.name: Associate Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Performs a substantial, negotiated support function, such as coordinating a production area, research, financing, talent access, or post-production. The title’s scope varies widely.

roles.name: Line Producer / Unit Production Manager (UPM)
roles.core_responsibility: Translates the creative plan into a practical budget, staffing plan, vendor plan, schedule, cash-flow plan, and production controls. Monitors spending and logistics daily. On some productions, these are separate jobs.

roles.name: Production Executive / Studio Executive
roles.core_responsibility: Represents the studio, financier, or commissioning entity; evaluates creative, budget, schedule, casting, and delivery decisions against the organization’s goals and contractual terms.

roles.name: Development Executive
roles.core_responsibility: Finds material, gives script notes, tracks market and talent opportunities, prepares project analyses, and moves viable projects toward packaging and greenlight.

roles.name: Financier / Equity Investor / Lender / Bond Company Representative
roles.core_responsibility: Provides capital or completion assurance; reviews financial risk, delivery milestones, insurance, and compliance with financing conditions. A completion-bond representative may monitor performance against the approved budget and schedule.

roles.name: Entertainment Attorney / Business Affairs Executive
roles.core_responsibility: Clears chain of title; negotiates and drafts option, acquisition, writer, talent, crew, financing, distribution, music, location, insurance, and vendor agreements; advises on rights, labor, privacy, and liability issues.

roles.name: Rights and Clearances Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Tracks permissions for source material, trademarks, artwork, clips, photos, publications, brands, and other third-party content used in the movie.

roles.name: Production Accountant / Controller
roles.core_responsibility: Maintains accounts payable, payroll documentation, cost reports, cash management, tax and incentive records, union reports, audit trails, and close-out accounting.

roles.name: Payroll Accountant / Payroll Service
roles.core_responsibility: Processes cast and crew payroll, fringes, withholding, union or guild requirements, timecards, and payroll reporting.

roles.name: Production Insurance Broker / Risk Manager
roles.core_responsibility: Obtains and administers required insurance; helps manage claims, certificates, loss prevention, and production-specific risk controls.

roles.name: Screenwriter
roles.core_responsibility: Creates the screenplay, including premise, structure, scenes, dialogue, character arcs, and revisions. May continue rewrites during pre-production and production.

roles.name: Story Creator / Author / Source-Material Rights Holder
roles.core_responsibility: Supplies the original story, book, article, life rights, or other underlying material, and licenses the applicable adaptation rights.

roles.name: Story Editor / Script Consultant
roles.core_responsibility: Assesses narrative logic, tone, character, structure, pacing, dialogue, audience clarity, and feasibility; provides notes rather than necessarily writing pages.

roles.name: Script Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Tracks drafts, revision pages, versions, distribution lists, production copies, and continuity-related script paperwork, especially on larger productions.

roles.name: Researcher / Historical Consultant / Subject-Matter Expert
roles.core_responsibility: Verifies factual, cultural, technical, medical, legal, military, scientific, language, period, or occupational details and advises the creative departments.

roles.name: Dialogue Coach / Dialect Coach
roles.core_responsibility: Prepares actors to deliver lines with accurate accent, speech pattern, pronunciation, language fluency, or vocal characterization.

roles.name: Sensitivity / Cultural Consultant
roles.core_responsibility: Advises on representation, cultural specificity, stereotypes, harmful inaccuracies, and context so creative choices are informed and respectful.

roles.name: Translator / Language Consultant
roles.core_responsibility: Translates dialogue and written assets; advises on idiom, subtitles, pronunciation, and cultural meaning.

roles.name: Director
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Establishes the film’s creative interpretation; directs performances, blocking, visual storytelling, pacing, tone, and coverage; collaborates with every department head; and makes central creative choices through final post-production.

roles.name: Second-Unit Director
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Directs separately scheduled material, commonly action, inserts, stunts, landscapes, vehicles, crowd work, or shots not requiring the principal cast. Works to the principal director’s plan and visual language.

roles.name: Additional Director / Action Director
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Directs a specifically assigned sequence or set piece, often when specialized action, scale, or schedule requires it.

roles.name: 1st Assistant Director (1st AD)
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Converts the shooting plan into daily execution: prepares the shooting schedule with production, runs the set’s operational flow, calls for departments and cast, manages time, coordinates safety with specialists, and protects the director’s ability to direct.

roles.name: 2nd Assistant Director (2nd AD)
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Prepares call sheets, coordinates cast call times and movements, maintains production reports and paperwork, liaises with cast, and supports the 1st AD’s next-day planning.

roles.name: 2nd 2nd AD / Additional 2nd AD
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Supports the 2nd AD on larger units, often with background actors, call sheet distribution, base camp, transport coordination, or cast logistics.

roles.name: 3rd Assistant Director / Set PA Lead
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Assists with floor management, background staging, lockups, cues, and communications. Job titles differ by territory.

roles.name: Script Supervisor (Continuity Supervisor)
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Records each take’s script changes, performance continuity, screen direction, props, wardrobe, timing, camera details, and editor-facing notes; flags continuity concerns and creates a reliable shooting record.

roles.name: Set Production Assistant (PA)
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Provides set-wide support: lockups, background movement, runs, signage, crowd control, walkie distribution, and communication under AD direction.

roles.name: Office Production Assistant
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Supports the production office with documents, phones, deliveries, filing, onboarding, supplies, reports, and general administrative coordination.

roles.name: Travel / Cast Coordinator
roles.department: Direction and the Assistant Director Department
roles.core_responsibility: Manages travel bookings, itineraries, accommodation details, pickups, and travel changes for cast or designated crew.

roles.name: Casting Director
roles.core_responsibility: Breaks down roles, sources performers, organizes auditions and screen tests, advises the director and producers, manages casting negotiations with business affairs, and assembles principal and supporting cast.

roles.name: Casting Associate / Casting Assistant
roles.core_responsibility: Sources talent, prepares audition materials, schedules sessions, maintains submissions, communicates with agents, and supports the casting director.

roles.name: Principal Actor
roles.core_responsibility: Performs a named major role; prepares character, dialogue, movement, and collaboration with director and departments.

roles.name: Supporting Actor / Day Player
roles.core_responsibility: Performs supporting or short-duration speaking roles.

roles.name: Background Actor / Extra
roles.core_responsibility: Performs non-speaking, atmosphere-building action in scenes. Background coordinators may hire, check in, costume, stage, and release them.

roles.name: Stand-in
roles.core_responsibility: Substitutes for a principal performer during lighting, camera, focus, and blocking preparation, enabling crew setup before the actor is needed.

roles.name: Photo Double / Body Double
roles.core_responsibility: Doubles for the actor in selected shots when face visibility, nudity, special skills, scheduling, or safety makes it appropriate.

roles.name: Stunt Performer / Stunt Double
roles.core_responsibility: Performs planned physical-risk action or doubles a cast member for that action. Works under approved safety procedures.

roles.name: Stunt Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Designs, rehearses, staffs, budgets, risk-assesses, and supervises stunts; coordinates with the director, 1st AD, special effects, safety specialists, and performers.

roles.name: Intimacy Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Plans and choreographs intimate scenes with informed consent, closed-set procedures, clear boundaries, modesty protections, and repeatable performance beats; liaises with actors, director, producers, wardrobe, and AD team.

roles.name: Choreographer / Movement Coach
roles.core_responsibility: Creates and rehearses dance, movement, fight, sports, or stylized physical performance. Combat choreography may be handled by a fight coordinator.

roles.name: Animal Coordinator / Animal Trainer
roles.core_responsibility: Provides trained animals, manages welfare and handling, coordinates shots, and works with safety and production requirements.

roles.name: Child-Welfare Professional / Studio Teacher
roles.core_responsibility: Supports the lawful, safe, educational, and welfare needs of child performers, subject to local rules.

roles.name: Production Coordinator
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Runs day-to-day production-office operations: crew onboarding, purchase orders, rentals, travel, vendor paperwork, schedules, contact lists, and department communication.

roles.name: Assistant Production Coordinator (APOC)
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Supports the coordinator with administrative and logistics tasks, records, order tracking, and crew communication.

roles.name: Production Secretary
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Maintains office correspondence, files, phones, meeting notes, and document distribution.

roles.name: Production Manager
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Oversees practical implementation of the budget and schedule, vendors, labor, department needs, and production problem-solving under the UPM/line producer.

roles.name: Production Scheduler
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Builds or maintains stripboards, one-line schedules, day-out-of-days reports, board changes, and schedule scenarios using script breakdowns and production constraints.

roles.name: Production Supervisor
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Coordinates or manages defined production operations, often on locations, units, or special projects; exact scope varies.

roles.name: Location Manager
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Scouts and secures locations; negotiates agreements; manages permits, site rules, neighborhood relations, access, parking, restoration, and location logistics.

roles.name: Assistant Location Manager / Location Scout
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Researches potential locations, gathers photos and details, supports permits, posts notices, manages location paperwork, and assists site operations.

roles.name: Permits Coordinator
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Obtains governmental, municipal, park, road, aviation, fire, and other permits needed for lawful shooting.

roles.name: Transportation Captain / Transportation Coordinator
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Plans vehicles, drivers, routes, parking, cast shuttles, crew transport, equipment movement, fuel, and compliance.

roles.name: Drivers
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Safely transport cast, crew, equipment, and materials according to production schedules and regulations.

roles.name: Unit Manager / Base-Camp Manager
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Runs the off-set support area, including cast trailers, crew holding, meals, restrooms, access, supplies, and daily base-camp logistics.

roles.name: Catering / Craft Services
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Catering supplies scheduled meals; craft services provides accessible snacks, beverages, and basic consumables throughout the shooting day.

roles.name: COVID / Health-Safety Coordinator or Medic
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Implements applicable health, medical-response, exposure-control, and emergency plans. Specific requirements depend on the jurisdiction and production.

roles.name: Set Medic / Nurse / Paramedic
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Provides on-set first-aid and emergency medical response within professional scope and production protocol.

roles.name: Safety Officer / Safety Consultant
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Identifies hazards, advises on controls, tracks safety meetings and documentation, and coordinates with AD, stunts, SFX, construction, and locations. Safety is a shared responsibility, not solely this role’s.

roles.name: Security Coordinator / Security Guard
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Protects people, equipment, locations, access points, crowd boundaries, confidential material, and restricted areas.

roles.name: Sustainability Coordinator / Green Steward
roles.department: Production Office, Scheduling, Logistics, and Safety
roles.core_responsibility: Reduces waste, tracks environmental practices, organizes recycling/composting, sources reusable materials, and supports sustainability reporting.

roles.name: Director of Photography (DP / Cinematographer)
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and leads the film’s photographic language: framing, lensing, camera movement, exposure, lighting collaboration, sensor/film choices, and image consistency.

roles.name: Camera Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Physically operates the camera to execute the DP’s and director’s shot design; on some shoots, the DP also operates.

roles.name: 1st Assistant Camera (1st AC / Focus Puller)
roles.core_responsibility: Builds and maintains the camera, changes lenses, pulls focus during takes, checks camera readiness, and helps protect image sharpness and equipment integrity.

roles.name: 2nd Assistant Camera (2nd AC / Clapper-Loader)
roles.core_responsibility: Operates the slate, manages camera reports and media handoff, organizes lenses/accessories, marks actors, and supports the 1st AC. Film productions may include loading duties.

roles.name: Camera Trainee / Utility Camera
roles.core_responsibility: Supports the camera team with batteries, cables, equipment prep, video support, lens management, and departmental logistics.

roles.name: Digital Imaging Technician (DIT)
roles.core_responsibility: Manages digital image workflows, data integrity in camera-facing systems, on-set color pipeline, exposure monitoring, and secure media transfer in coordination with production and post.

roles.name: Data Wrangler / Digital Loader
roles.core_responsibility: Safely copies, verifies, logs, backs up, and transfers recorded media according to a documented chain-of-custody and backup workflow.

roles.name: Steadicam Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Operates a body-supported stabilized camera system for moving shots.

roles.name: Drone Pilot / UAS Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Plans and flies authorized aerial-camera operations, observes aviation rules, performs safety checks, and coordinates with locations, AD, camera, and safety teams.

roles.name: Remote Head / Technocrane / Specialty-Camera Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Operates specialized camera-support systems such as cranes, remote heads, robotic rigs, underwater systems, or vehicle mounts.

roles.name: Video Assist Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Records or streams a monitoring feed for director, script supervisor, departments, playback, review, or continuity needs.

roles.name: Still Photographer / Unit Photographer
roles.core_responsibility: Captures approved production stills for marketing, publicity, continuity, archival, and promotional use without disrupting principal photography.

roles.name: Behind-the-Scenes (BTS) Videographer / EPK Crew
roles.core_responsibility: Records approved making-of and electronic press kit material, interviews, and promotional footage.

roles.name: Gaffer / Chief Lighting Technician
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the electrical/lighting crew; implements the DP’s lighting plan; selects fixtures, power distribution, control systems, and crew workflow.

roles.name: Best Boy Electric
roles.core_responsibility: Assists the gaffer with crew, equipment, orders, electrical logistics, paperwork, maintenance, and power planning.

roles.name: Lamp Operator / Set Electrician
roles.core_responsibility: Installs, powers, controls, adjusts, and maintains lighting fixtures and associated cable systems.

roles.name: Generator Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Runs and monitors generators and electrical distribution safely, including fuel, load management, grounding, and required procedures.

roles.name: Key Grip
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the grip department; designs and supervises camera support, rigging, light-shaping support, dollies, tracks, overheads, safety rigging, and physical control of light.

roles.name: Best Boy Grip
roles.core_responsibility: Assists the key grip with crew coordination, equipment tracking, truck organization, orders, and grip logistics.

roles.name: Dolly Grip
roles.core_responsibility: Sets tracks and operates dollies, cranes, or related camera-movement systems in coordination with camera and grip leadership.

roles.name: Grip
roles.core_responsibility: Builds and operates stands, flags, diffusion, rigging, camera-support equipment, frames, mounts, and physical light-control tools.

roles.name: Rigging Gaffer / Rigging Grip
roles.core_responsibility: Pre-rigs lighting, cable, support, and rigging infrastructure before the main unit arrives; later removes it safely.

roles.name: Board Operator / Lighting Console Programmer
roles.core_responsibility: Programs and operates lighting-control boards, dimmers, DMX networks, practical effects, and lighting cues where used.

roles.name: Production Designer
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the film’s physical visual world: locations, sets, color, texture, architectural language, period detail, props, graphics, and visual coherence with the director and DP.

roles.name: Art Director
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Converts the production designer’s concepts into drawings, schedules, budgets, construction packages, department coordination, and practical execution.

roles.name: Assistant Art Director
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Supports research, technical drawings, set dressing coordination, graphics, procurement, and production-art logistics.

roles.name: Illustrator / Concept Artist / Storyboard Artist
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Produces visual concepts, renderings, storyboards, diagrams, and presentation material that clarify intended design and shots.

roles.name: Draftsperson / Set Designer / CAD Technician
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Creates plans, elevations, construction drawings, models, measurements, and technical layouts for sets and scenic elements.

roles.name: Graphic Designer / Graphic Artist
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Designs diegetic graphics such as signs, labels, newspapers, screen interfaces, packaging, logos, maps, and period documents. Requires clearance-aware work when real brands or materials are involved.

roles.name: Set Decorator
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Furnishes and dresses sets with furniture, textiles, lamps, art, objects, and environmental detail that support character, story, and period.

roles.name: Leadperson / Set-Dressing Lead
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Organizes dressing crews, warehouse workflow, movement, installation, and strike of set-decoration elements.

roles.name: Set Dresser
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Places, adjusts, maintains, and removes decor, furniture, drapery, and environmental items on sets.

roles.name: Buyer / Set-Decoration Buyer
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Sources, rents, purchases, tracks, returns, and budgets furnishings and decorative items.

roles.name: Prop Master
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the properties department, sourcing and maintaining all hand props, hero props, practical props, weapons interfaces, and actor-use items; coordinates continuity and safety.

roles.name: Assistant Prop Master / Props Assistant
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Prepares, places, tracks, resets, repairs, and transports props; supports the prop master during takes and changes.

roles.name: Prop Maker / Fabricator
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and builds custom props, replicas, breakaways, soft props, specialty objects, and mechanical items.

roles.name: Armorer / Weapons Master
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Lawfully procures, inventories, secures, prepares, and supervises weapons or weapon replicas; enforces strict protocols with production, AD, stunts, and performers. Applicable laws and qualified specialists are essential.

roles.name: Construction Coordinator / Construction Manager
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Budgets, schedules, staffs, and supervises construction of sets, platforms, scenic elements, and location modifications.

roles.name: Carpenter / Scenic Carpenter / Welder / Metalworker
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Constructs physical sets, structures, supports, props, and special build elements to approved designs and safety specifications.

roles.name: Scenic Artist / Painter
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Paints and finishes sets, textures, murals, aging, faux surfaces, signage, and scenic treatments.

roles.name: Plasterer / Sculptor / Model Maker
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Creates specialized architectural, sculptural, miniature, molded, or textured elements.

roles.name: Greensperson / Greens Coordinator
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Sources and maintains plants, trees, turf, flowers, soil, and other natural dressing; manages watering, replacement, and environmental appearance.

roles.name: Set PA / Art PA
roles.department: Production Design, Art, Props, Construction, and Set Decoration
roles.core_responsibility: Supports department-specific errands, materials movement, paperwork, set maintenance, and coordination.

roles.name: Costume Designer
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Develops the wardrobe concept for characters, story eras, palettes, silhouettes, changes, fittings, and visual storytelling; manages costume budget and team.

roles.name: Assistant Costume Designer
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Supports research, sourcing, fittings, breakdowns, communication, continuity, and departmental coordination.

roles.name: Costume Supervisor
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Manages costume operations: budgeting, hires, purchases, rentals, records, transport, fittings, maintenance, and inventory.

roles.name: Shopper / Buyer
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Sources and purchases or rents wardrobe items, fabrics, accessories, and supplies.

roles.name: Cutter / Tailor / Seamstress / Costume Maker
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Builds, alters, repairs, fits, duplicates, and maintains costumes.

roles.name: Set Costumer / Wardrobe Assistant
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Dresses actors, preserves costume continuity, performs quick changes, manages set bags, and resets wardrobe between takes.

roles.name: Ager-Dyer / Breakdown Artist
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Alters garments to appear aged, dirty, distressed, bloodied, weathered, duplicated, or period-appropriate.

roles.name: Key Makeup Artist / Department Head
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and leads makeup looks, continuity, hygiene, application workflow, and team scheduling.

roles.name: Makeup Artist
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Applies and maintains standard character makeup, touch-ups, sweat control, continuity, and product hygiene.

roles.name: Special Makeup Effects Artist / Prosthetics Designer
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Creates and applies prosthetics, wounds, aging, creatures, appliances, blood effects, and other practical character transformations.

roles.name: Key Hair Stylist / Department Head
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and leads hair looks, wigs, continuity, maintenance, and hair-team operations.

roles.name: Hair Stylist / Wigmaker
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Cuts, styles, maintains, applies, and tracks hair and wigs; handles continuity and on-set touch-ups.

roles.name: Barber
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Provides period, character, grooming, shaving, and haircut services where needed.

roles.name: Personal Assistant to Principal Talent / Glam Team
roles.department: Costume, Hair, Makeup, and Personal Appearance
roles.core_responsibility: Supports individual talent’s approved logistical and personal-preparation needs; scope is governed by employment and production arrangements.

roles.name: Production Sound Mixer
roles.department: Sound, Playback, and Music During Production
roles.core_responsibility: Records clean production dialogue and location sound; chooses microphones and recording workflow; monitors sound quality; manages sound reports and sound-team operations.

roles.name: Boom Operator
roles.department: Sound, Playback, and Music During Production
roles.core_responsibility: Places and operates boom microphones, coordinates with camera and lighting, hides or manages microphone positions, and listens for sound issues.

roles.name: Utility Sound Technician
roles.department: Sound, Playback, and Music During Production
roles.core_responsibility: Wires performers, manages radio mics, batteries, frequency coordination, equipment, plant mics, and sound-team logistics.

roles.name: Playback Operator
roles.department: Sound, Playback, and Music During Production
roles.core_responsibility: Supplies, syncs, and operates music, dialogue, timecode, video, or other playback cues during filming, especially for music, dance, screens, or lip-sync.

roles.name: Music Supervisor (Production Consult)
roles.department: Sound, Playback, and Music During Production
roles.core_responsibility: Advises on music needs, early licensing strategy, temp music, artist relationships, and clearance implications that affect the shoot.

roles.name: Special Effects Supervisor (SFX)
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and executes practical physical effects such as wind, rain, snow, smoke, fire, explosions, breakaways, mechanical effects, water effects, and atmospherics, with rigorous safety planning.

roles.name: Special Effects Technician
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Builds, tests, operates, resets, and maintains practical-effect systems under SFX supervision.

roles.name: Pyrotechnician
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Handles permitted pyrotechnic effects under applicable licenses, safety plans, fire requirements, and specialist procedures.

roles.name: Special Effects Makeup / Practical Creature Team
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Creates physical character effects; collaborates with makeup, art, props, and VFX.

roles.name: Visual Effects Supervisor (VFX Supervisor)
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Plans effects that will be created or enhanced digitally; advises the director and DP on shooting methods, plates, tracking, greenscreens, references, and post-production execution.

roles.name: On-Set VFX Supervisor / VFX Producer
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Captures needed VFX data and references, tracks shots, coordinates vendors and schedule, and ensures photography supports the post-production plan.

roles.name: VFX Data Wrangler / Witness-Camera Operator / Lidar Technician
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Captures camera metadata, lens data, HDRIs, texture references, scan data, witness footage, and measurements for accurate digital reconstruction.

roles.name: Virtual Production Supervisor
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Coordinates LED-volume, real-time engine, camera-tracking, virtual-art, and live-compositing systems used during photography.

roles.name: Fight Coordinator / Fight Choreographer
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Designs and rehearses staged combat with repeatable beats, performer training, prop handling, and safety coordination.

roles.name: Vehicle Coordinator / Picture-Car Coordinator
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Sources and prepares vehicles; coordinates picture cars, driving action, permits, mechanics, towing, continuity, and safe vehicle use.

roles.name: Marine Coordinator / Water Safety Team
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Plans watercraft, diving, lifeguard coverage, weather monitoring, rescue capability, and water-based filming safety.

roles.name: Aerial Coordinator
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Coordinates aircraft, aerial rigs, safety approvals, timing, and specialized personnel for aerial work.

roles.name: Animal Effects / Creature Effects Technician
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Supports animatronics, puppetry, trained animal interfaces, or mechanical creature work.

roles.name: Puppeteer / Puppet Fabricator
roles.department: Special Effects, Visual Effects, Action, and Specialty Departments
roles.core_responsibility: Designs, builds, performs, or coordinates practical puppets and creature mechanisms.

roles.name: Post-Production Supervisor
roles.core_responsibility: Builds the post plan, budget, schedule, vendor strategy, workflow, delivery calendar, and communication system from editorial through final masters.

roles.name: Post-Production Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Tracks editorial assets, schedules, approvals, turnover materials, deliveries, invoices, databases, and post-office communication.

roles.name: Editor / Picture Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Selects and assembles takes; shapes scene construction, performance, rhythm, clarity, tone, and overall story; collaborates closely with director and producers through locked picture.

roles.name: Assistant Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Organizes footage, syncs dailies, maintains project databases, prepares cuts, tracks versions, creates turnovers, handles exports, and supports editorial workflow and backups.

roles.name: Apprentice Editor / Editorial Assistant
roles.core_responsibility: Supports media organization, logging, exports, paperwork, deliveries, and other editorial operations.

roles.name: Dailies Colorist / Dailies Operator
roles.core_responsibility: Applies approved looks to camera material, produces review files, and preserves metadata and color consistency for editorial and production review.

roles.name: Dailies Producer / Dailies Lab Technician
roles.core_responsibility: Coordinates processing, transcoding, quality checks, delivery, security, and tracking of daily footage.

roles.name: Post-Production Accountant
roles.core_responsibility: Tracks post spending, vendor costs, purchase orders, cost reporting, final billing, and financial close-out.

roles.name: Archival Producer / Archival Researcher
roles.core_responsibility: Sources archive footage, stills, audio, documents, and licenses; tracks terms, provenance, and delivery requirements.

roles.name: Titles Designer / Motion Graphics Designer
roles.core_responsibility: Creates opening titles, end credits treatments, screen graphics, lower thirds, and motion-design elements for the picture.

roles.name: VFX Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Budgets, schedules, contracts, tracks, and delivers VFX work across internal teams and vendors; manages client approvals and shot priorities.

roles.name: VFX Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Maintains shot databases, notes, turnover materials, review schedules, deliveries, vendor communication, and asset tracking.

roles.name: VFX Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Prepares and tracks VFX turnovers, temp composites, editorial versions, reviews, and returned final shots.

roles.name: Compositor
roles.core_responsibility: Combines photographed elements and digital elements into a seamless image using mattes, keying, rotoscoping, tracking, paint, color, and integration work.

roles.name: Rotoscope / Paint Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Creates masks, removes unwanted elements, repairs imagery, prepares clean plates, and supports compositing.

roles.name: Matchmove / Tracking Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Reconstructs camera and object movement so digital elements align correctly with photographed footage.

roles.name: Layout Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Establishes shot composition, camera, staging, scale, and timing for digital scenes.

roles.name: Modeler
roles.core_responsibility: Builds 3D objects, characters, environments, and props.

roles.name: Texture / Look-Development Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Creates surface detail, materials, shaders, and appearance tests for 3D assets.

roles.name: Rigger
roles.core_responsibility: Builds controllable digital skeletons, deformers, and control systems for animation.

roles.name: Animator
roles.core_responsibility: Creates character, creature, object, or camera performance and movement.

roles.name: FX Simulation Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Simulates fire, smoke, destruction, particles, water, cloth, crowds, and other dynamic effects.

roles.name: Lighting / Rendering Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Lights digital scenes, renders final image passes, and prepares assets for compositing.

roles.name: CG Supervisor / Sequence Supervisor
roles.core_responsibility: Leads technical and artistic quality for a CG or sequence team; solves workflow and shot-level issues.

roles.name: Virtual Art Department (VAD) Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Creates real-time digital environments, assets, previs materials, and virtual-production content.

roles.name: Supervising Sound Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the sound-post creative and technical plan; supervises dialogue, effects, Foley, ADR, mixing, schedule, budget, and final sound deliverables.

roles.name: Dialogue Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Cleans, organizes, edits, and matches production dialogue; prepares it for mixing and identifies ADR needs.

roles.name: ADR Supervisor / ADR Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Plans and records replacement dialogue, cues actors, selects takes, edits replacements, and integrates them with production sound.

roles.name: Foley Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Performs custom footsteps, cloth, and object sounds in sync with the locked picture.

roles.name: Foley Editor / Foley Mixer
roles.core_responsibility: Edits, organizes, and balances Foley recordings for the final soundtrack.

roles.name: Sound Effects Editor / Effects Designer
roles.core_responsibility: Selects, edits, creates, and layers environmental, vehicle, weapon, creature, designed, and practical sound effects.

roles.name: Field Recordist / Sound Designer
roles.core_responsibility: Records or creates distinctive source material and develops the film’s sonic identity.

roles.name: Re-recording Mixer
roles.core_responsibility: Balances dialogue, ADR, Foley, effects, ambience, and music into final theatrical and home-release mixes; creates required mix versions.

roles.name: Music Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Spots music with the team, conforms score and source cues to picture changes, manages timing, prepares sessions, and coordinates music deliverables.

roles.name: Composer
roles.core_responsibility: Writes original score supporting story, character, pacing, and emotional structure; collaborates with director, music editor, and music supervisor.

roles.name: Orchestrator
roles.core_responsibility: Expands the composer’s material into arrangements for the intended ensemble or orchestra.

roles.name: Arranger
roles.core_responsibility: Adapts music for a particular style, ensemble, sequence, or performance need.

roles.name: Music Supervisor
roles.core_responsibility: Sources, licenses, budgets, clears, negotiates, and delivers pre-existing songs and recordings; manages artist/label/publisher relationships and cue documentation.

roles.name: Music Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Tracks licenses, cue sheets, contracts, music files, sessions, credits, and stakeholder communication.

roles.name: Music Contractor
roles.core_responsibility: Hires musicians, ensembles, conductors, recording facilities, and related session personnel.

roles.name: Conductor / Performers / Recording Engineer
roles.core_responsibility: Rehearses and records score performances; captures and prepares high-quality music recordings.

roles.name: Songs Writer / Lyricist
roles.core_responsibility: Writes original songs or lyrics for the film.

roles.name: Colorist
roles.core_responsibility: Grades the completed image for exposure, contrast, color, shot matching, mood, and consistency while preserving creative intent across viewing formats.

roles.name: Online Editor / Finishing Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Conforms the locked edit to highest-quality source material; integrates final VFX, titles, reframes, cleanups, and technical finishing work.

roles.name: Conform Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Relinks and reconstructs the final timeline from original media, VFX, color, and approved edit decisions.

roles.name: DI Producer / Finishing Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Schedules and manages digital-intermediate, color, mastering, approvals, assets, vendor coordination, and deliverables.

roles.name: Quality-Control (QC) Technician
roles.core_responsibility: Tests picture, sound, subtitles, captions, legal cards, timing, encoding, and packaging for technical defects or specification compliance.

roles.name: Mastering Engineer / Digital Cinema Package (DCP) Technician
roles.core_responsibility: Creates, encrypts where applicable, verifies, and packages theatrical or platform masters such as DCPs, IMF packages, broadcast masters, and home-video encodes.

roles.name: Localization Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Coordinates dubbing, subtitles, captions, translated graphics, regional versions, approvals, and delivery requirements.

roles.name: Subtitler / Captioner
roles.core_responsibility: Creates accurate timed subtitles, captions, speaker identifiers, sound descriptions, and accessibility-compliant text assets.

roles.name: Descriptive Audio Writer / Narrator
roles.core_responsibility: Creates or performs audio description that makes visual information accessible to blind or low-vision audiences.

roles.name: Accessibility Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Plans and tracks captioning, subtitle, descriptive-audio, and accessible-deliverable requirements.

roles.name: Legal Deliverables Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Assembles chain-of-title, music, errors-and-omissions, cue sheets, releases, licenses, credits, ratings, and other documentary deliverables required by distributors or insurers.

roles.name: Credits Coordinator
roles.core_responsibility: Collects contractual credits, verifies spelling/order and guild requirements, coordinates approvals, and delivers final end-credit text.

roles.name: Sales Agent
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Represents the film to potential distributors and buyers, prepares sales materials, negotiates territory-based deals, and coordinates market strategy.

roles.name: Domestic / International Distributor
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Acquires release rights and executes distribution across theatrical, streaming, broadcast, transactional, physical media, or other channels; manages release strategy and revenue reporting.

roles.name: Distribution Executive / Distribution Coordinator
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Plans delivery, release calendars, territories, platforms, marketing assets, booking, reporting, and distributor-facing operations.

roles.name: Marketing Producer / Campaign Manager
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Develops the marketing plan, budget, audience positioning, assets, campaign calendar, partnerships, and performance tracking.

roles.name: Publicist / Unit Publicist
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Manages press strategy, media access, set visits, interviews, press releases, talent publicity logistics, and reputation-sensitive communication.

roles.name: EPK Producer
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Produces electronic press-kit content: interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, featurettes, clips, and approved promotional packages.

roles.name: Trailer Editor / Creative Advertising Editor
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Cuts trailers, teasers, TV spots, social videos, and other campaign edits to position the film for an audience.

roles.name: Key Art Designer / Poster Artist
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Designs posters, title treatments, billboards, thumbnails, and visual campaign assets.

roles.name: Social Media Manager / Community Manager
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Plans, publishes, moderates, and measures approved social content and audience engagement.

roles.name: Publicity Stills Photographer
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Supplies still images for press, exhibitors, partners, and advertising.

roles.name: Festival Strategist / Festival Producer
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Identifies suitable festivals, manages submissions, coordinates premiere strategy, materials, travel, press, and festival relationships.

roles.name: Theatrical Booker / Exhibitor Relations Manager
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Negotiates cinema bookings, screens, playdates, terms, promotional support, and box-office reporting.

roles.name: Ratings / Classification Coordinator
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Prepares submissions and documentation for ratings or classification boards in relevant territories.

roles.name: Film Commissioner / Incentives Liaison
roles.department: Marketing, Publicity, Sales, Distribution, and Exhibition
roles.core_responsibility: Supports location production with regional introductions, permitting guidance, and tax-incentive or rebate-process coordination.

roles.name: Documentary Director / Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Develops the journalistic or observational approach, obtains access, guides interviews, manages ethics and consent, and shapes the final argument or story.

roles.name: Field Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Arranges contributors, travel, releases, research, access, interview logistics, and story development in the field.

roles.name: Journalist / Investigative Researcher
roles.core_responsibility: Verifies claims, develops sources, reviews records, documents evidence, and helps ensure editorial rigor.

roles.name: Interview Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Researches participants, designs interview lines, prepares briefing materials, and coordinates releases and logistics.

roles.name: Archive Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Locates, researches, clears, licenses, budgets, and tracks historical footage, stills, news, documents, and other archives.

roles.name: Fact Checker
roles.core_responsibility: Independently verifies names, dates, quotations, claims, source attributions, statistics, and on-screen factual statements.

roles.name: Legal Reviewer / Defamation Counsel
roles.core_responsibility: Reviews factual assertions, releases, fair-use analysis, privacy issues, and risk-sensitive editorial content before release.

roles.name: Animation Director
roles.core_responsibility: Leads the performance, timing, movement, acting, and visual storytelling of animated material.

roles.name: Animation Producer
roles.core_responsibility: Budgets, schedules, staffs, tracks, and delivers the animation pipeline.

roles.name: Character Designer
roles.core_responsibility: Designs character appearance, turnarounds, expressions, costumes, and model sheets.

roles.name: Environment / Production Designer
roles.core_responsibility: Defines settings, props, palettes, visual world rules, and design assets for animated scenes.

roles.name: Storyboard Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Draws sequential visual storytelling, staging, shots, action, and dialogue beats.

roles.name: Story Reel / Animatic Editor
roles.core_responsibility: Edits boards, scratch dialogue, timing, music, and panels into a working editorial blueprint.

roles.name: Layout Artist
roles.core_responsibility: Establishes camera, staging, composition, background placement, and scene geometry.

roles.name: 2D Animator / 3D Animator
roles.core_responsibility: Creates motion and performance for characters, creatures, props, or cameras.

roles.name: Animation Supervisor
roles.core_responsibility: Maintains animation quality, consistency, performance standards, and technical execution across teams.

roles.name: Clean-up Artist / Inbetweener
roles.core_responsibility: Refines drawings and creates transitional frames in 2D animation workflows.

roles.name: Background Painter / Matte Painter
roles.core_responsibility: Creates environments and backdrop imagery for animated scenes.

roles.name: Technical Director / Pipeline TD
roles.core_responsibility: Builds and maintains tools, automation, asset-management, rendering, and data workflows across the animation pipeline.

roles.name: Render Wrangler / Render Farm Manager
roles.core_responsibility: Manages rendering resources, job queues, failed frames, data storage, and final image delivery.
